title: Scalable extraction of pongamol from Pongamia pinnata for synthesis and application of colloidally stable iron nanoparticles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48666-48677
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04181C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Renjie Cui, Mengying Wu, Anna Galang, Franklin Perez, Vanessa Partrige Hing, Nesha May Octavio Andoy, Ruby May Arana Sullan, Kris Sanghyun Kim
Pongamol, a flavonoid from Pongamia pinnata, was purified through two-solvent recrystallization and applied towards the synthesis of pongamol-FeNPs which were further tested for bacterial viability with P. defensor and methylene blue dye degradation.
